## Goal
- Fix three landing-page production issues (empty deals API, analytics endpoint error, web domain not resolving) and deploy verified end-to-end with proof evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Must show live HTTP proof for each fix — "No PASS without runtime evidence"
- Deploy to Render via GitHub push to `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` main branch
- Backend live URL: `https://ivx-holdings-platform.onrender.com`
- AWS/S3/CloudFront credentials may be stored in Owner Variables table, not process.env
- No credentials available in local sandbox (SUPABASE_URL, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, IVX_OWNER_TOKEN all empty)

## Progress
### Done
- Created `backend/api/ivx-landing-go-live.ts` — single endpoint that seeds deal, verifies analytics, triggers S3 deploy, verifies landing-deals API
- Added public analytics summary endpoint: `GET /api/ivx/landing-analytics/public` (no owner auth required)
- Registered new endpoints in `backend/hono.ts` (lines ~770, ~6484)
- Fixed `handleJVDealsList` in `backend/api/ivx-public-features.ts` — was selecting non-existent columns (`featured_image_url`, `gallery_urls`, `slug`, `location`, `target_raise`, `minimum_investment`, `projected_roi`, `term_length`, `display_order`)
- Updated query to select actual schema columns: `id,title,project_name,description,property_address,city,state,property_type,total_investment,expected_roi,term_months,status,published,photos,created_at,updated_at`
- Added `{ count: 'exact' }` to Supabase query so count is not null
- Added error logging to `handleJVDealsList`
- Fixed internal fetch port in go-live endpoint (was hardcoded `10000`, now uses `process.env.PORT || '3000'`)
- Fixed seed deal to match actual `jv_deals` schema columns
- Pushed commits: `ff78dbb3`, `d79981eb`, `cef42182`, `3c51327f` to `landing-golive` branch → `github/main`
- Triggered go-live endpoint 3 times; latest result: landing-deals API returns `count: 4` ✅, analytics summary works ✅

### In Progress
- Commit `3c51327f` (removes `display_order` from seed deal update to fix unique constraint violation) pushed but NOT yet deployed to Render — need to wait ~90s and verify via `/health`
- S3/CloudFront deploy failing — `awsCredentialsConfigured: false`, missing `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` in process.env

### Blocked
- AWS credentials not in process.env on Render — landing-deploy endpoint reports `Missing AWS credentials: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Checked process.env and Owner Variables table.`
- Cannot check Owner Variables status endpoint — requires `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` which is not in sandbox env
- GitHub push protection blocks commits containing `.rork/history` files with secrets — workaround: fresh branch from `github/main` + cherry-pick

## Key Decisions
- Created single "go-live" endpoint rather than fixing each issue separately — allows one-call verification with proof
- Made analytics GET public (separate `/api/ivx/landing-analytics/public` route) rather than removing owner auth from existing dashboard endpoint
- Used actual `jv_deals` schema columns from `expo/scripts/supabase-full-schema.sql` instead of assumed column names

## Next Steps
1. Wait for Render to deploy commit `3c51327f` — verify via `curl https://ivx-holdings-platform.onrender.com/health` (check commit hash matches)
2. Trigger go-live again: `curl -X POST "https://ivx-holdings-platform.onrender.com/api/ivx/landing-go-live" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"confirm":"IVX_LANDING_GO_LIVE_2026"}'`
3. Fix AWS credentials issue — investigate why Owner Variables table lookup fails in `backend/api/ivx-landing-full-deploy.ts` (check `getRawOwnerVariableValue` / `getIVXOwnerVariableRuntimeValue` for `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_REGION`, `CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID`)
4. Verify all 5 go-live steps pass with ✅
5. Verify `ivxholding.com` resolves (HTTP 200) after S3 deploy succeeds
6. Show final certification proof
